newsitem.title: USA: US spot prods down late day, gasoline diffs drop.
newsitem.headline: US spot prods down late day, gasoline diffs drop.

text.p: U.S. spot product prices were weaker late Friday, pressured by the drop in NYMEX prices and gasoline differentials in thin market activity
NYMEX heating oil slipped nearly 1 cent by the close, while gasoline saw a modest 0.12 cent dip.
Activity in the No. 2 oil market remained thin with few barrels changing hands, according to traders.
Concerns about reports of increased gasoline shipments from Europe to the U.S. East Coast may have lent pressure to the gasoline diffs, though market players said a major bearish impact was unlikely.

"I think with Tosco (Bayway, New Jersey) down, any gosoline coming in will find a home," one trader said, referring to the maintenance at the 140,000 barrels per day catalytic cracker expected for the next two weeks.

U.S. Gulf (USG) conventional unleaded M4 gasoline for the back 2nd cycle on the Colonial Pipeline was offered at 2.75 cents under the NYMEX, down about 0.50 cent on the day, while later January barrels were talked between 3.25 to 3.50 cents under the screen.
New York Harbor (NYH) prompt conventional unleaded M5 gasoline was offered at 2.00 cents under the print.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
